close_rule: Entries for a period must be entered (entry_date) on or before that period's close_date.
posting_days: Entries post on business days (Monday to Friday, excluding company holidays).

manual_je_approval.rule: MANUAL entries with total debits of 1000000 cents ($10,000.00) or more need the Controller. Smaller entries can be approved by the Accounting Manager or the Controller. Preparer and approver must be different people.

preparers: Journal entries are prepared by Finance staff. System sources post as service accounts SVC-EXPENSE (expense claims and payouts) and SVC-GL (billing, receipts, fees, depreciation).
intercompany: Every NW-US entry to 1310 Intercompany Receivable must have an NW-CA entry to 2310 Intercompany Payable with the same IC reference and amount.
